title: Elementary localization denominator product
statement: Multiplication by a denominator turns a displayed localization fraction into its numerator.

proof.text: Use the defining relation for localization fractions with multiplier one.

lean.statement: theorem localization_mk_mul_denominator {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (a b : R) (hb : b ∉ P) : Localization.mk (a * b) (⟨b, hb⟩ : P.primeCompl) = Localization.mk a 1
